writing2.prompt: The chart compares electricity supplied by three fictional sources to a school microgrid in 2023 and 2025. Describe the main differences and make relevant comparisons. Write at least 150 words.

chart.title: Electricity supplied to a model school microgrid, 2023 and 2025

teacherKeyFacts: Solar supply increased from 25 to 60 MWh (+35).
Wind supply increased from 12 to 22 MWh (+10).
Grid electricity fell from 95 to 70 MWh (−25).
Grid electricity remained the largest single source in 2025.
Total recorded supply rose from 132 to 152 MWh.
writing2.grading: five-level Ministry rating scale; teacher review

notes: Numbers describe a fictional model, not national energy statistics.
